lines.zh: 我踩着枯枝往林子里走。
lines.en: I pick through dead twigs into the woods.

lines.zh: 灰白的树皮一根根立着。
lines.en: The pale bark stands in bare columns.

lines.zh: 我的角算是这一带的招牌。
lines.en: My horns are the pride of this place.

lines.zh: 灰烬从树上慢慢飘下来。
lines.en: Ash drifts down from the branches.
I skirt a pool of black water.
I walk slowly, without hostility.

lines.zh: 蹄子落在软土上不出声。
lines.en: My hooves fall silent on soft earth.
The light in these woods is always grey.
I stop to crop a little grass.
The wind turns the dry grass over.
I shake the ash off my back.
I follow the open lane through the trees.
I stand chewing a tender twig.
Ash settles on my back in flakes.
I lean on a charred trunk.
The wind stirs the ash again.
This wood is actually very quiet.
I'm listening to something far off.
My horns curve beautifully.
I'm waiting for the ash to settle.
You've come a little too near.
I look up at you without hostility.
What's that in your hands?

lines.zh: 这片林子不太欢迎生人。
lines.en: Strangers aren't very welcome here.
My horns aren't here for you to view.

lines.zh: 你身上有别的林子的味道。
lines.en: You smell of another forest.
I step back and size you up.
Come closer and I'll leave.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一段灰土。
lines.en: There's a stretch of ash between us.
I raise my horns slowly.
I tossed my head from the pain.

lines.zh: 角上挨了一下，我甩甩头。
lines.en: Something struck my horn and I shake my head.
My forelegs buckled briefly.
I'm a little angry now.

lines.zh: 我钻进灰树后，只露半个背。
lines.en: I slip behind an ash tree, showing half my back.
A lot of ash has settled on me.
I'm still standing fairly steady.

lines.zh: 再打，我这对角可要顶了。
lines.en: Hit me again and these horns will answer.
There's grass enough in this wood.
What do you mean to do with that?

lines.zh: 我不太相信递过来的手。
lines.en: I don't much trust an offered hand.
It doesn't smell like food.
I tilted my head to look.
My horns would reach it first.
Set the fruit on the ground; don't hold it up.
I took one slow step closer.
That won't fill one mouthful.
My whole body swayed.
I raised a forehoof and backed off.
That gave me a start.

lines.zh: 我的角尖擦过你的腰带。
lines.en: My horn tip grazes your belt.
Ash flew up from the impact.
Don't crowd in any further.
Let's both step apart.
I dropped my hind legs to steady.
Are you from around here too?
Let's share this grass.
Your horns are a little thinner.
We needn't stand very close.
This wood can hold the both of us.
There are shoots under the ash.
Let's wait for the ash to settle.
One touch of horns and it's settled.
I pick up a broken branch.
Your thing fell in the ash.
It's covered in ash.

lines.zh: 我用角把地上的东西挑开。
lines.en: I flick the thing aside with my horn.
I can't drag this bundle of wood.
This thing isn't mine.
I don't mean to touch it.
Let go of my horn!
You've come far too close.
I lift my head slowly.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子已经对准你的方向。
lines.en: My hooves are already turned your way.
One more step and I'll run.
I back toward the tree trunk.
My horns are already aimed at you.
I toss my head as a warning.
One kick and the ash rises.
My hind legs have taken the weight.
I won't back away this time.

lines.zh: 灰林的猎人，都想要我的角。
lines.en: Every Ashen Woods hunter wants my horn.
I'll stand right here without moving.
A patch of ash shifts on the ground.
It's about to start.
I'm watching you from behind the tree.

lines.zh: 你进一步，我就贴着树影退。
lines.en: One step closer and I slide back along the tree shadows.
My hoofprints lie in the ash.
My horns scraped the bark.
I'm panting, but not afraid.
You're nearly behind me now.

lines.zh: 角尖朝前，我盯着你的手。
lines.en: Horns forward, I watch your hands.
I stepped sideways up the slope.
The ground here is slippery.
You've closed off my retreat.
I keep my eyes on your hands.
I've stepped back another half pace.
You're still pressing closer.

lines.zh: 我抖落背上的灰，站稳了。
lines.en: I shake the ash off my back and plant my feet.
I'm building speed to charge you.
My hind legs are coiled and ready.
My hoofprints lead straight to you.
You hear a branch snap.

lines.zh: 我在灰里看清你的位置。
lines.en: I can see your position through the ash.
My horns caught you.
My forehooves crash down before you.
You were knocked back a few paces.
That one hit heavily.
You're caught between tree and horn.
Your armor rang out.
Ash splashed all over you.
I pull back a little.
That wasn't especially polite.
I kicked off my hind legs again.
You've grabbed my horns.
I wrench my head free.

lines.zh: 你退到我打不到的地方。
lines.en: You've backed out of reach.
I stand there, panting.
My horns flick your hand aside.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩在你脚边的土上。
lines.en: My hooves stamp the soil by your feet.
My charge broke a branch.
My shove sent you sliding away.
That charge went wide.
I step out of the deep ashen woods.
The bark is burned down to grey.
A fine layer of ash covers the ground.

lines.zh: 灰从树上落下来，落在我的角上。
lines.en: Ash drifts down from the trees onto my horns.
The wind draws the ash into a line.
I lift my eyes to the ashen wood.
Footsteps are coming from far off.

lines.zh: 我的角在灰天里很显眼。
lines.en: My horns stand out against the grey.

lines.zh: 我把前蹄在地上刨了刨。
lines.en: I paw at the ground with a forehoof.
It's very quiet here.
I start walking between the trees.
Ash blew into my eyes.
Fire has caught my back again.
I slid from the slope to its foot.
Water pours straight up my nose.
The ash bursts and I land on my back.

lines.zh: 箭卡在我的角根，拔不动。
lines.en: The arrow's stuck at the base of my horn.

lines.zh: 那阵光让我的毛都竖了。
lines.en: That light raised my coat straight up.

lines.zh: 这林子里草越来越少了。
lines.en: There's less and less grass here.
The thunder made me bolt in place.
No ground below, only ash.
